parameters.content:
## 🏗 Site event
Upsert Site → set the Primary Contact, and link every associated Company as a Simpro customer (fan-out at **Split Out Site Customers**, looped one at a time).

## 🏢 Company event
Upsert Company → link every associated Site to the Simpro customer (fan-out at **Split Out Company Sites**, looped one at a time).

## 👤 Contact event
Upsert Contact in Simpro. Nothing else to link in this direction.

## 📄🔧 Deal event
Upsert the deal's first Contact, Company and Site (in that order), then route by pipeline: Default → **Upsert Quote in Simpro**, Jobs → **Upsert Job in Simpro**.

nodes.name: Receive Record
nodes.notes: Called once per changed record by [SPL] HubSpot -> Simpro (Scheduled Updates). Input data mode must read 'Accept all data'. Item shape matches the HubSpot webhook: { body: [ { objectId, objectTypeId, subscriptionType } ] }.
